verdict.rationale: The only evidence is community discussion of a new Fastmail EU (Amsterdam) region, which implies users can choose where data is stored. The same report says Fastmail states it cannot guarantee data stays only in the EU, so strict residency is not delivered. Another user cites data sitting under both Australian and US jurisdictions. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of region selection, a residency guarantee keeping data in the chosen region, details on which regions exist and how to choose or migrate between them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Criticism of Fastmail's new EU (Amsterdam) region: they state they can't guarantee data remains only in the EU
